description: Step-2 intermediate representation, revised per Poki 10-game analysis (12 design patterns P1-P12, 14 validation rules V1-V14) and the 3-book comedy creation framework v1.1 (Judy Carter: premise attitude; Greg Dean: mechanical twist; Li Dan: mechanic diet + authenticity). AI expands user uploads into this schema; it populates GameSpec factors and seeds RuntimeSpec IR generation.

muteToggle.description: P10: every Poki title had one.

noAutoplayBeforeInput.description: V7: no audio before first interaction.

sfx.description: V7: one entry per player action.

designRef.description: Element/sprite id of the source drawing, or 'generated'.

silhouette.description: P9/V8: readable at 32px, distinct from background.

coop.description: P12/V10: the proven co-op pattern is shared-keyboard.

leaderboard.description: P8: required for endless win types.

loopLink.description: Comedy-framework v1.1 (Li Dan): one sentence on how this mechanic serves the core loop. Every mechanic must earn its place or be cut.

sourceRef.description: Uploaded element id this mechanic derives from (authenticity); omit if purely systemic.

sourceRef.description: Uploaded element id this mechanic derives from (authenticity); omit if purely systemic.

hook.description: P1/P2/P3, V2/V3: the first-60-seconds contract. Required because it predicts playability better than any other section.

plot.description: P11: one sentence max. May be empty.

premise.description: Comedy-framework v1.1 (Judy Carter): the emotional stance of the game's premise. Forces the AI to find the emotional truth in the source material before designing any mechanic.

statement.description: One line: why this world matters emotionally.

provenance.description: Per top-level section: where it came from.

sources.description: Uploads this design was expanded from.

difficulty.description: P5/V5: structured ramp; Poki hits escalate, never plateau.

level1BotClearable.description: V5: a weak bot must clear level 1.

rampStartSec.description: e.g. ~30 for speed ramps (Subway Surfers pattern).

maxDistinctInputs.description: V4: core loop uses at most 2 distinct inputs.

luckSources.description: P4: declare where luck lives; skill still decides outcomes.

twist.description: Comedy-framework v1.1 (Greg Dean): the mechanical surprise. The player expects the assumption (Target Assumption); the game delivers the reinterpretation. A game without a legible twist is a template with art.

assumption.description: What the player expects from the setup.

reinterpretation.description: What the game actually does — must differ from the assumption.

failHandling.description: P6: death is priced in seconds, not menus.

grading.description: P8: level games grade per level; endless types pair with leaderboard.
